fields.Name: T161 - Models in Production Control Tower
fields.Description: Exercises the PSProduction reactive control tower (ObserveProperty-driven model list + deployment-state derivation + on-demand run history) — distinct from the immutable-model Registry panel.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Predictive Studio app, open the 'Models' door and select the 'Models in Production' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Success is the production control tower rendering: a KPI strip (Published / Scheduled / Bound / Idle counts), a list of published models each with a deployment-state badge (Bound / Scheduled / Idle), and on selecting one, a Deployment detail card plus a Run history section. If no published models exist, the 'No models in production yet' empty state is a pass. You do NOT need to run or schedule a model.

judgeValidationCriteria: Either the KPI strip + published-model list with deployment-state badges + deployment detail renders, OR the 'No models in production yet' empty state renders
When a published model is selected, its deployment status and a run-history section are shown
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
